title: Étale base-change arrows commute with restriction of coefficients
statement: Let Λ and Λ′ be commutative rings in Type(u+1), φ:Λ→Λ′ a ring homomorphism, and Y --e→ T, Y --h→ X, T --g→ S, X --p→ S a cartesian square of schemes [sbc-def-base-change-square], with g quasi-compact and quasi-separated. For every integer q and sheaf G of Λ′-modules on T_et, the degree-q base-change arrow [sbc-def-base-change-map] of the Λ-module sheaf Res_φ G is isomorphic in the arrow category of Λ-module sheaves on X_et to Res_φ applied to the degree-q base-change arrow of G.

proof.text: Apply the coefficient-comparison theorem to obtain source and target isomorphisms commuting with the two base-change arrows.
Package the commuting square as an isomorphism in the arrow category using Arrow.isoMk'.

lean.statement: theorem exists_baseChangeHomologyMap_restrictScalars_arrow_iso {Λ Λ' : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [CommRing Λ'] (φ : Λ →+* Λ') {X S T Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ S} {g : T ⟶ S} {e : Y ⟶ T} {h : Y ⟶ X} (sq : IsPullback e h g p) [QuasiCompact g] [QuasiSeparated g] (q : ℤ) (G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ')) : Nonempty (Arrow.mk (baseChangeHomologyMap Λ sq q ((Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology φ).obj G)) ≅ Arrow.mk ((Sheaf.restrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology φ).map (baseChangeHomologyMap Λ' sq q G)))
